forms.newLicenseHint: The monthly amount is the contracted quantity times the unit price.
forms.newServerHint: License, support and backup costs start at zero and are set later, under Costs.
forms.editSupplierHint: Contact, email, phone and website are fully replaced by what is submitted.
forms.priceAdjustmentHint: Enter only the new monthly amount; difference, percentage and annual impact are computed.
forms.updateCostsHint: The four values replace the current ones. The total is their sum.
forms.resizeServerHint: Fields left blank keep their current value.
forms.renewContractHint: Renewal extends the term and does not change amounts. Use an adjustment for that.
forms.aboveThreshold: This adjustment exceeds the alert threshold and will raise a notification.
forms.reasonHint: Recorded in the timeline; it is what explains the change in an audit.
forms.editLicenseHint: Fix registration data. Amount, quantity and status are not changed here.
forms.editServerHint: Fix registration data. Costs and resources are not changed here.
forms.editUnitHint: Fix name and description. Code and type remain unchanged.
forms.environmentHint: Only fix this if the server was registered in the wrong environment.
forms.editUnitFixedHint: Code and type define the position in the hierarchy and are not changed here.
